The Defective Detective - Album 2: Serah Investigates

Black is Beautiful

"Black is beautiful Look at what they built"

[Verse] Fence line ends where the old roads bend One last gate at the edge of them Coda walks like she’s been here before Centaur guard by the weathered door

Bobbie smiles before we speak Scoops Coda up right off her feet Laughs so loud the whole post shakes “About time, troublemaker”

[Pre-Chorus] I thought black meant danger Thought black meant gone Thought black meant everything The system told us was wrong

[Chorus] Black is beautiful Look at what they built Hands in the open No shame No guilt

Black is beautiful Past the lines they drew A world without a color Still somehow more true

Black is beautiful No file No rank No lie

Just people learning how to live Without asking why

[Verse] Clinic made from scrap and glass Children run through orchard paths Bars with patched-up neon signs Workshops buzzing late at night

Elf and goblin side by side Kitsune laughing, centaurs ride No one checks what shade you are No one measures who gets far

I look at Coda She just grins “Yeah… I may have undersold this a bit.”

[Pre-Chorus] She says, “I lied because the air out there Has ears I do not trust But here you speak the truth out loud And no machine turns it to dust”

[Chorus] Black is beautiful Look at what they made A thousand little freedoms No system ever gave

Black is beautiful Past the Company view You call a place abandoned When it stops belonging to you

Black is beautiful No badge No chain No score

Just people helping people Build another kind of door

[Bridge] Old contract Older blood Written long before our names Anything inside this border Stays outside the Company’s claims

Off limits Off grid Off every polished map But don’t mistake that for “open” Not everyone gets welcomed past

You need a reason Need a bond Need somebody trusted near

Coda shrugs and keeps on walking And suddenly it’s very clear

[Break] Every face knows her

Every hand waves

Someone shouts, “Coda!”

Someone says, “You’re late!”

Kamira blinks Andy stares I fold my arms and try not to smirk

Resistance leader?

Well

That explains a lot of her attitude at work

[Pre-Chorus] Then Coda lowers her voice Not from fear From fact

“The elf is real The trust is hard And you don’t get that back”

[Chorus] Black is beautiful Now the map has changed The place we thought was lawless Just learned how to live unchained

Black is beautiful If Anna crossed this line Then maybe what they took from her Didn’t vanish Just go blind

Black is beautiful No tracker in the sky No color over anyone No reason left to lie

[Final Chorus] Black is beautiful Let the system call it wild I’ve seen cleaner truth in these streets Than in any sanctioned file

Black is beautiful And if this is what they fear Maybe freedom looks exactly like What they said not to come near

Black is beautiful One gate One contract One zone

And for the first time in a long time

The world feels less alone

[Outro] Bobbie shuts the gate behind us Music spills from somewhere west Coda points toward a distant light

“She’s there.”

Andy takes a breath Kamira checks her lens I look around once more

[Spoken] [clean voice only]

“So this is the Black Zone…”

Coda smiles.

“No.”

“This is what comes after it.”
